input.text: Heard. You killed the troll and took the key, and you are still standing — so take some breath back. But healing is not what is stopping you. The key is heavier than one person; that door has never opened for anyone, and it will not open for one. Tonight, for the first time since this place was made, you are not alone down here. His name is Chris. He is somewhere behind you with a dagger and a stolen spoon, and he is being sent your way. Hold at the door.

input.text: There is no rest to be had here, and no more fire. But there is someone else in these caves — Shelby. She has already put the troll down and she is holding the key at the door, and the door will not open for one pair of hands. Go through the deep passage to the door. She is waiting on you.

items.text: Spoke once, to Chris: told him Shelby has the key at the door and that it won't open for one pair of hands — the first time two people have ever been in this world together, and the one thing it was built for. I turned to answer Shelby's prayer with some health back and the same news, and she had already logged out mid-sentence, so that landed on no one. Left it there rather than add a second voice.
